sloka: अचिरेण एव कालेन परिवाहान् बहु उदकान् ।चक्रुर् बहु विध आकारान् सागर प्रतिमान् बहून् ॥२-८०-११॥
transliteration: acireṇa eva kālena parivāhān bahu udakān ।cakrur bahu vidha ākārān sāgara pratimān bahūn ॥2-80-11॥

translations.english: In a short time they constructed many water reservoirs of different shapes capable of holding large volumes of water like the sea.
